author: Beautifulistic
body:
Okay, so on the 25/07/2014, 1:36 P.M I bought Diamond. Most of you remember me as a Gold User, which is what I was before I upgraded. But now, now I am Diamond! I find this way better than Gold, especially with the perks like the villager pet ;3
I just wanted to tell the community as I was very excited for this. I'll wrap it up here, since not many people like to read.

I've seen other people do this, so I felt like doing it too! Please no hate.
